text:
ana: Heads up - between 03:05-03:12 UTC we saw a spike in inference 99p latency for us-west1 rack8 and ~4 eviction events. NVML logs show repeated clock-throttle transitions + a few Xid 79s on card gpu3.
infra-bot: Alert: gpu-thermal-throttle detected on rack8-node04 (4 events in 8m). Linked: https://ops.internal/alerts/1948765432
mike: Oof. Is this sustained or short blips? Any powercap changes?
ana: short blips but correlated with autoscaler bursts. powercap on node04 shows 250W steady, but nvml shows brief drops to 165W then back.
raj: can you paste the nvml/smi snapshot? Also any ECC counts?
sophie: rolling logs from node04 attached in the deploy log, but quick grep shows ECC correctable ++ on gpu3 (couple hundred). That could explain regression.
ana: paste: ```nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,UTILIZATION,POWER,ERRORS -i 3
Temperature: 78 C
Power Draw: 245 W
Power Limit: 250 W
Throttle Reasons: GPU, Power
Xid Errors: 79, 79, 79
ECC Errors: Correctable: 212
```
raj: sounds like adaptive power control on the PSU combined with a sensor hiccup causing powercap enforcement. We saw similar with that PSU firmware in rack8 before. Recommendation: drain node04 gpu3, repro locally with synthetic load, collect dmesg + pcie logs.
mike: agree. Oncall, can you kick a drain and set host maintenance? Also put autoscaler to soft-throttle for the rack to avoid further backpressure.
oncall-rot: kicking drain for rack8-node04 gpu3 -> setting host:maintenance=true. autoscaler policy set: reduce-burst to 40% for us-west1-rack8.
sophie: for quick triage, run: ```sudo nv-hostengine --collect --period 30s --out /tmp/node04-gpu3.log && sudo dmesg | grep -i pcie > /tmp/pcie.log```
ana: started the collectors. also capturing PMBus logs from the PSU.
raj: if repro succeeds, swap the PSU to spare and retest. If ECC correctable keeps climbing under low load, schedule replacement for the GPU — likely flaky memory or thermal cycling.
mike: timeline? we should aim to get node back within 2-3 hours. If node eviction rate > 10% we'll failover jobs to other racks.
ana: updated: after draining gpu3, no more new evictions for 10m, latency 99p back to baseline. Collectors uploaded to https://s3.ops/internal/rack8/node04/gpu3/1948765432_logs.tar.gz
raj: thanks. next steps: schedule PSU firmware rollforward in maintenance window, replace GPU if ECC continues to rise after firmware. I'll create a follow-up ticket.
mike: add regression test to infra-monitor to detect short powercap dips (>=20% drop <1m) and alert with rack-level autoscaler hold.
oncall-rot: noted. Closing this thread but keeping ticket open: INFRA-7891. :thumbsup:
